text: DSH Director Toolkit（DSH Web 插件）把粗略的 3D 想法整理成制作方向。scene_director 会给出构图、镜头、灯光、材质、几何、动作、渲染建议、五步制作流程及双语展示文案，适用于 Blender、Three.js、Houdini 和 C4D。基础功能无需额外配置；可选的 scene_director_v4 使用 DeepSeek 润色 brief，需在服务端设置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。

DSH Director Toolkit turns rough 3D ideas into plans. scene_director provides camera, composition, lighting, materials, geometry, render guidance, build steps, and bilingual showcase copy for Blender, Three.js, Houdini, or C4D. Optional DeepSeek V4 refinement requires a server-side DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
想把一句 3D 概念扩展成镜头、灯光和材质方案。
有没有工具能根据场景 brief 给出分步骤的建模制作计划？
让 DSH 帮我为 Blender 的产品渲染规划构图和打光。
我想给 Three.js 场景生成适合 WebGL 的渲染建议。
Turn my rough 3D concept into a camera, lighting, and material direction.
Help me make a practical shot plan for a Blender or Three.js scene.
DSH Director Toolkit 的功能「镜头与构图规划」：根据 brief 生成镜头焦段、机位、主体占比、负空间和背景构图建议。 通过 scene_director 提交 brief，结果包含对应的结构化方向内容。
DSH Director Toolkit 的功能「灯光、材质与几何方向」：为场景给出主辅光、材质层次和几何搭建的具体方向。 通过 scene_director 提交 brief，结果包含对应的结构化方向内容。
DSH Director Toolkit 的功能「分软件渲染与制作步骤」：按 Blender、Three.js、Houdini 或 C4D 给出渲染建议，并列出五步制作顺序。通过 scene_director 提交 brief。
DSH Director Toolkit 的功能「展示文案与图像提示词」：从同一场景方向生成双语标题、展示帖、图像提示词和标签。 通过 scene_director 提交 brief，结果包含对应的结构化方向内容。
想从产品草图得到适合渲染的 3D 场景方向和标题文案。
需要按目标软件调整渲染设置，并列出从灰模开始的制作顺序。

> Turn a rough 3D idea into a shot you can build.

DSH Director Toolkit is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for 3D artists and technical designers. It turns a rough brief into a direction pack for Blender, Three.js, Houdini, or C4D:

@lhmd/dsh-director-toolkit README · See it first：Open the [GitHub Pages showcase](https://lhmd.github.io/dsh-director-toolkit/) for the Blender short film, a four-chapter multi-asset story, and a browser-native Three.js study.

The film has three beats: reveal the cyan silhouette, let the eye find camera, then lift the relic above the plinth. The source scene is [`examples/cyclopean-porcelain.blend`](examples/cyclopean-porcelain.blend); the build script is [`scripts/blender-script-demo.py`](scripts/blender-script-demo.py).

@lhmd/dsh-director-toolkit README · See it first：The four story frames are rendered from [`scripts/render-case-videos.py`](scripts/render-case-videos.py): chrome orbit, memory garden, brutalist archive, and cloth robot. The direction data is in [`docs/examples/scene-suite.json`](docs/examples/scene-suite.json).

@lhmd/dsh-director-toolkit README · Plugin shape：`scene_director` is the local-first deterministic tool. `scene_director_v4` is an optional Harness/server adapter that defaults to `deepseek-v4-pro` and reads `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` only from the server environment. The runtime `director-toolkit` Skill tells the agent when to direct a Blender, Three.js, Houdini, or C4D brief.

This repository follows the DSH Profile Bundle shape:

@lhmd/dsh-director-toolkit README · Install into Harness：```bash
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-director-toolkit
dsh web
```

For the optional V4 pass, configure the credential in the Harness/server environment:

```bash
export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="replace-with-a-rotated-key"
```

@lhmd/dsh-director-toolkit README · Editable playground：The changeable local editor lives in [`playground/`](playground/).

```bash
python3 -m http.server 4175 --directory playground
```
